title: Docs
description: Docs as a graph: a principle is an item with its point and intent, and what upholds it (rules, tests, parts, screens, agent actions) serves it, linked rather than written out. A page about a principle draws those links.

types.title: Principle
types.description: Something the product holds to, in a sentence or two of point and intent. What upholds it serves it; it is retired when it stops holding.

path.description: Where its page is published, as people-decide.
